source_derived_event_facts.cue6: linked descriptor B3 F0 E0 1B AD 28 07 00; policy B3 is exclusive, priority5, voice mask07; selected audible voice minimum is one, not fixed at three
source_derived_event_facts.cue13: linked descriptor D3 A0 E0 1F B2 76 03 00; exclusive priority6, voice mask03
source_derived_event_facts.cue6_terminal: decoded 101 emitted commands from linked cue6 stream $AD28; emitted zero terminator at $AE78; audio_command_end must be observed with slot0 still cue6 and X=$AE79. This endpoint was derived from command lengths and linked bytes, not a next-label assumption.
source_derived_event_facts.PSG: audio_mix_write entry arrays/shadow and selected slot map are needed to derive the complete expected bus transaction. audio_mix_write writes every tone latch even muted. Credit cue6 output only when the actual FF51 A-byte sequence matches the model and at least one actual period/attenuation store belongs to a selected audible cue6 voice; a latch alone is insufficient.
source_derived_event_facts.post_mix: audio_mix_write_done is $A492; PC $A498 is after JSR audio_music_busy and STA $02D4. Read actual published busy only at this post-PSG boundary.
source_derived_event_facts.IRQ_FRONT: fbiq_publish is $0ECC. Source layout places INC $0093 at $0ED9 and its post-increment PC at $0EDB. Require live module-byte/map qualification, the actual sequence write, current front ID, matching valid player metadata/pointer, framebuffer bytes, and release after audio+front commit.
